'''James Robin Bernard Cockett''' (born May 4, 1952)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.freebmd.org.uk/cgi/information.pl?cite=iWAfjdsxs84MVVIiXP%2BVUQ&scan=1|title=Index entry|accessdate=24 September 2023|work=FreeBMD|publisher=ONS}}</ref> is a British [[computer scientist]] and [[professor]] at the [[University of Calgary]].<ref name=gs>{{Google scholar id|luNcQyEAAAAJ&hl | Robin Cockett}}</ref>

==Education==
Cockett received his [[Bachelor of Science]] from the [[University of Warwick]] in 1974,<ref name=profile>{{cite web |title=ROBIN COCKETT |url=http://pages.cpsc.ucalgary.ca/~robin/ |website=University of Calgary |access-date=24 September 2023}}</ref> and earned his [[PhD]] from the [[University of Leeds]] in 1979 for his research in [[injective]]s and [[Localization of a category|localization]]s in [[category theory]], studying under [[Alfred Goldie]].<ref>{{cite web |title=James Robin Bernard Cockett |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=72477 |website=Mathematics Genealogy Project |access-date=24 September 2023}}</ref>

==Career and research==
Cockett has been a professor of computer science at the University of Calgary since 1991, previously holding the title of professor at the [[University of Tennessee]].<ref>{{cite news |title=55 UT Faculty Members Win Tennessee Tomorrow Grants |url=https://www.newspapers.com/image/774357074 |work=The Knoxville News-Sentinel |date=February 18, 1983 |page=A5}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |author=L.E. Parker |title=A Robot Navigation Algorithm for Moving Obstacles. |journal=Master's Thesis |date=1988 |page=2 |publisher=University of Tennessee}}</ref>

Cockett works primarily in the fields of [[category theory]], categorical programming, and [[quantum programming]].<ref name=profile/> Cockett is a member of the organizing committee for the ''Foundational Methods in Computer Science'' (FMCS) conference,<ref name=profile/> an annual workshop for researchers in [[theoretical computer science]] and category theory supported by the [[Pacific Institute for the Mathematical Sciences]] (PIMS).<ref>{{cite web |title=Foundational Methods in Computer Science |url=https://www.pims.math.ca/scientific-event/160602-fmcs |website=Pacific Institute for the Mathematical Sciences |access-date=24 September 2023}}</ref>

===Selected publications===
His most cited publications<ref name=gs/> include:
*''Weakly distributive categories''<ref>{{cite journal |author1=J.R.B. Cockett |author2=R.A.G. Seely |title=Weakly distributive categories |journal=Journal of Pure and Applied Algebra |date=January 13, 1997 |volume=114 |issue=2 |pages=133–173 |doi=10.1017/CBO9780511525902.004}}</ref>
*''Restriction categories I: categories of partial maps''<ref>{{cite journal |author1=J.R.B. Cockett |author2=Stephen Lack |title=Restriction categories I: categories of partial maps |journal=Theoretical Computer Science |date=January 6, 2002 |volume=270 |issue=1–2 |pages=223–259 |doi=10.1016/S0304-3975(00)00382-0|arxiv=math/0610500 |s2cid=12444870 }}</ref>
*''Differential categories''<ref>{{cite journal |author1=R.F. Blute |author2=J.R.B. Cockett |author3=R.A.G. Seely |title=Differential categories |journal=Mathematical Structures in Computer Science |date=November 1, 2006 |volume=16 |issue=6 |pages=1049–1083 |doi=10.1017/S0960129506005676|s2cid=11818257 }}</ref>
*''Cartesian differential categories''<ref>{{cite journal |author1=R.F. Blute |author2=J.R.B. Cockett |author3=R.A.G. Seely |title=Cartesian differential categories |journal=Theory and Applications of Categories |date=December 10, 2009 |volume=22 |issue=23 |pages=622–672 |url=http://www.tac.mta.ca/tac/volumes/22/23/22-23.pdf}}</ref>
*''Differential structure, tangent structure, and SDG''<ref>{{cite journal |author1=J.R.B. Cockett |author2=G.S.H. Cruttwell |title=Differential structure, tangent structure, and SDG |journal=Applied Categorical Structures |date=May 7, 2013 |volume=22 |issue=2 |pages=341–417 |doi=10.1007/s10485-013-9312-0|s2cid=254230142 }}</ref>

==Personal life==
Cockett has been married to fellow University of Calgary professor Polly Knowlton Cockett since 1984,<ref>{{cite news |title=ENGAGEMENTS |url=https://www.newspapers.com/image/437276457/ |work=The Boston Globe |date=March 25, 1984 |page=84}}</ref> they have three children together: Audrey Lane, Rowan, and Grayson.<ref name=volunteer>{{cite news |title=15th ANNUAL LEADERSHIP AWARDS |url=https://www.newspapers.com/image/488047802/ |work=Calgary Herald |date=April 21, 2011 |page=N5}}</ref> Cockett is an avid cross-country skier, taking part in the [[Canadian Birkebeiner]] on more than one occasion,<ref>{{cite news |title=CROSS-COUNTRY SKIING |url=https://www.newspapers.com/image/476431890 |work=Edmonton Journal |date=February 19, 2004 |page=D5}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=LOCAL CROSS-COUNTRY SKIING |url=https://www.newspapers.com/image/476486223/ |work=Edmonton Journal |date=February 16, 2007 |page=C7}}</ref> as well as volunteering as an instructor.<ref name=volunteer/>

Cockett and his wife have volunteered for numerous environmentally-focused initiatives, including as lecturers for the Calgary Parks Biodiversity Conservation program at [[Nose Hill Park]],<ref name=volunteer/> and with the [[Alberta Wilderness Association]],<ref name=volunteer/> where his family's work earned them an award from the city of Calgary.<ref name=volunteer/>
